result.summary: Run 45313003577 (snapshot c7ad257) had three test faults, no product fault. (1) pg, 11 × 57P01 uncaughtException: no test terminates connections on purpose; node:test runs a test's after hooks in the order of registration (measured on Node 22.23.4), so the hook of fixtures/pg-env.js freshDatabase — registered first — ran `drop database … with (force)` before the hooks that end the test's own superuser clients (`t.after(() => c.end())` in audit-chain world, auth-race-pg pgApp, rls RLS-2/3/4). The force drop sent 57P01 FATAL to those still-open pg.Client objects, which have no error listener, so the error event became an uncaught exception charged to the test running at that moment. Every failing test is one that leaves such a client to an after hook; every passing one ends its clients inside the body. The app pools are not affected (pg.js keeps pool.on('error')). The files do not share a database: each test makes its own sai_t_<hex> database. (2) AC-1 AssertionError «row 10: prev_hash»: the test's own read `select id::text as id … order by id` sorts by the text alias (1, 10, 11, …, 19, 2, …), so after row 1 it met row 10 and compared row 10's prev_hash with row 1's hash; the writer's chain and verify (readAuditPage orders by audit_log.id) are right. (3) VB-1: the CHANGED list of vercel-build.test.js lacked the four account pages whose kk region the open build cuts (decisions/0137 Addition 3), as A7/A8 lacked them in public-build and public-pages.

changes.what: client() records each client it opens on a database of freshDatabase (removed again on its 'end'); the drop hook of freshDatabase ends the still-open ones before `drop database … with (force)`. A later end() by the test is a no-op (pg 8.23.1 Client.end returns at once when _ended). No assertion, test or timeout changed; the force drop stays.
changes.criterion: The pg tests of REQ-114 c2/c5 (AUTH-RACE-1..5), REQ-115 c1-3 (RLS-2..4) and c10 (AC-1..4) assert the behaviour of the app on real Postgres; a teardown that kills the test's own client is no part of any criterion, so the test was at fault.

changes.what: `order by id` → `order by audit_log.id` (the column, not the text alias), with a comment why. The assertions are unchanged.
changes.criterion: REQ-115 c10: the chain is in id order (the design M2AUTH 4.11; verifyAudit/readAuditPage order by audit_log.id); the test's text order departed from it.

changes.what: adds admin-totp.html, login.html, reset.html, setup.html (the same four as CHANGED of public-build.test.js). VB-1 still requires the output tree to equal app/public without examples.html and every other file byte-equal; the cut of the four pages is proved by PB-2.
changes.criterion: REQ-111 c9 / the code design 4.11 with decisions/0137 Addition 3: the open build cuts the kk region of each account page, so these files are among the files the public set changes.
